title: Investigative research
activation: someone claims this, check it against the facts
find out whether their numbers are actually true
what actually happened, the timeline does not add up
verify this before we publish it
a conclusion someone will decide, spend, accuse, publish, or rely on
due diligence on a vendor or company, background investigation, competitive or market claim, incident or timeline reconstruction, verify this claim
sources classed, independence checked, survive a hostile reader, primary sources
standDown: a single-fact question one authoritative source settles, what year was it released
brainstorm names, draft a tweet, an opinion, speed over certainty
outcomes: a verified finding with sources classed and independence checked
inputs: the records and material provided or reachable through declared sources
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: a load-bearing claim that cannot be cited is marked unverified, never asserted
